trait.name: HP
trait.text: HP = 60 + 10 for each spell level above 6

trait.name: Seige Monster (Ankylosaur Only)
trait.text: The spirit deals double damage to objects and structures.

trait.name: Tough
trait.text: Add half the spell's level (round down) to any Strength or Constitution saving throw the spirit makes.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The spirit makes a number of attacks equal to half this spell's level (round down).

action.name: Bite (Tyrannosaur Only)
action.text: Melee Attack Roll: Bonus equals your spell attack modifier, reach 10ft. Hit: 2d10 + 5 plus the spell's level Piercing damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Grappled condition (escape DC equal to your spell save DC), and it has the Restrained condition until the grapple ends

action.name: Gore (Triceratops Only)
action.text: Melee Attack Roll: Bonus equals your spell attack modifier, reach 5 ft. Hit: 1d10 + 5 plus the spell's level Piercing damage. If the target is a Huge or smaller creature and the spirit moved 20+ feet straight toward it immediately before the hit, the target takes an extra 1d10 Piercing damage and has the Prone condition.

action.name: Slam
action.text: Melee Attack Roll: Bonus equals your spell attack modifier, reach 10 ft. Hit: 1d10 + 5 plus the spell's level Bludgeoning damage.

monster.name: Plant Spirit [5.5e]
monster.vulnerable: fire (tree only), slashing (Fungus or Vine only)

trait.name: Hit Points
trait.text: HP = 50 + 10 for each spell level above 5

trait.name: Siege Monster (Tree Only)
trait.text: The spirit deals double damage to objects and structures.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The spirit makes a number of attacks equal to half this spell's level (round down).

action.name: Slam (Tree or Vine Only)
action.text: Melee Attack Roll: Bonus equals your spell attack modifier, reach 5 ft. Hit: 1d10 + 3 plus the spell's level Bludgeoning damage.

action.name: Spore Spray (Fungus Only)
action.text: Melee or Ranged Attack Roll: Bonus equals your spell attack modifier, reach 5 ft. or range 30 ft. Hit: 1d4 plus the spell's level Poison damage, and the target has the Poisoned condition until the end of its next turn. If the target already has the Poisoned condition, it instead takes an extra 3d4 Poison damage.

action.name: Twist Away (Vine Only) (Bonus Action)
action.text: The spirit takes the Dash or Disengage action.

trait.name: Hit Points
trait.text: HP = 30 (Brute only) or 20 (Flyer or Stalker only) + 5 for each spell level above 2

trait.name: Flyby (Flyer Only)
trait.text: The familiar doesn't provoke an Opportunity Attack when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

trait.name: Talented
trait.text: Add half the spell's level (round down) to any ability check or saving throw the familiar makes.

action.name: Multiattack
action.text: The familiar makes a number of Rend attacks equal to half this spell's level (round down). The familiar can replace one of these attacks with Prowl if available.

action.name: Rend
action.text: Melee Attack Roll: Bonus equals your spell attack modifier, reach 5 ft. Hit: 1d8 + 3 plus the spell's level Force damage.

action.name: Prowl (Stalker Only)
action.text: The familiar moves up to half its Speed without provoking Opportunity Attacks. At the end of this movement, the familiar can take the Hide action.
